semantics.pipeline: source -> read -> semantic graph -> write -> read -> normalize -> compare
semantics.equivalence_rule: Equivalence compares normalized machine-significant semantics, not byte identity.
semantics.extension_rule: Supported unknown extensions survive roundtrip according to extension policy.
semantics.failure_rule: Any lost/created/changed machine-significant semantic node makes the roundtrip non-equivalent.

invariants.rule: A Contract Format 1.4 conformance claim is backed by reproducible machine-readable fixtures, validation results and exact profile/version identity.

hard_gates.condition: roundtrip equivalence defined as byte equality only
